jobs.description: In order to fill a fixed-term position in full-time (39.83 hours/week = 100%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for severalPostdocs (2 years) (m,f,x)The Cluster of Excellence "CASA: Securing the Digital Society" is funded by DFG for the years 2026-2032 with approximately 53 million euros. CASA aims to strengthen the resilience of our digital society. The emergence of disruptive technologies in recent years, especially artificial intelligence and quantum computers, has caused substantial new challenges for cybersecurity research. In the second funding phase, CASA will specifically address these challenges. Thematic priorities include the security of quantum technologies, protection against Al-based disinformation and societal polarization, and new approaches to defending against ransomware. In addition to technical questions, it also investigates the interaction of human behavior and cybersecurity. Research at CASA, which is based at the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security, follows a strongly interdisciplinary approach. Researchers from the fields of computerscience, cryptography, electrical engineering, mathematics, and psychology work together in an unique constellation in Europe. This holistic approach is unparalleled and holds the potential for scientific breakthroughs. Ruhr-University Bochum (RUB) and its Faculty of Computer Science offer an excellent environment for aspiring young researchers. 20 years ago, the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security (HGI) was founded here. lt is now one of Europe's most prestigious institutions for basic computer security research. The HGI maintains extensive networks with leading research institutions worldwide and with media and industry. Moreover, it has produced numerous successful security startups. The pioneering work of the HGI forms the basis for the Cluster of Excellence CASA.Scope: full-timeDuration: fixed-term, 2 yearsStart: at the earliest possible dateApply by:  2026-11-09Your tasks:- Our goal is to attract postdoctoral researchers and enable them to conducttheir research with the mentorship of a PI. jobs.description: OUR COMPANYAt Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.The PositionAre you passionate about innovation, finding cutting-edge solutions and creating value where it matters, around the globe? We foster innovative thinking as well as an agile and collaborative way of working to advance our novel programs and capabilities in Therapeutic Area Inflammation.The Global TA Inflammation, (Senior) HEOR  Manager, brings technical expertise, driving Outcomes Research (HEOR) and Patient Related Outcomes fostering our patient centric drive. His/she will support the TA Market Access Head by providing oversight, direction, and functional support on HEOR & PRO & Access projects. He/she will be working closely with Value and Evidence Networks within our Global Business Unit and with external stakeholders.Tasks & responsibilities- In your new role, you develop and execute on health economics outcomes research (HEOR) & PRO strategies, demonstrating the medical and economic payer-relevant needs to optimize value of BI products.- In this function, you generate evidence that development of the Target Product Profile (TPP), clinical development plan of our pipeline compounds.- In consideration of regulatory body request and trial development, pre and post launch you will ensure relevant and new patient-reported outcome (PRO) measurement strategies to ensure that the patient perspective is captured in our clinical trial program and interact with regulatory authorities, closely collaborating with other functions.- Besides, you ensure efficient and timely development of key HEOR deliverables (i.e. payer value stories, payer engagement tools, GVDs, economic models, retrospective database analyses, indirect comparisons, real world evidence data) for assigned BI products.- Finally, yet importantly, you develop and maintain relevant partnerships with payers, academic research institutions, contract research organizations and other HEOR thought leaders in order to optimize the impact of HEOR & PRO research.Additional responsibilities as Senior Manager:- You will define long-term global development strategies for the assets, in close collaboration with the global Marketing and global Medical counterparts, to ensure optimal patient access.- In addition, you will draft long-term publication strategies, considering the long-term global market development.Requirements- Graduate degree, preferably PhD in health economics, Medicine (MD), public health, pharmacy, focusing on Health Technology Assessment, PRO, Pharmacy, Medicine, Public Health- Several years of pharma industry experience, with positions in areas of relevance for HEOR, PRO consulting or payer authorities- Multiple years of direct experience undertaking Health Technology Assessments (HTA) & PRO including Evaluations for Regulatory and health authority interventions of pharmaceutical products- Conducting or being part of a team working on non-interventional studies and RWE programs- Demonstrated experience of successful regulatory, reimbursement negotiations for launching new products in key markets- Proven track record of delivering value demonstration materials that resulted in timely patient access and adoption- Proven ability in appraising clinical evidence (both RCTs and operational evidence)- Profound knowledge and expertise to formulating COA strategies including validation methods, administration of measures and statistical analyses of COA data- Excellent communication and influencing skill both in internal and external contextAdditional requirements as Senior HEOR Manager:- Long-term pharma industry experience, with positions in the areas of health economics, pricing & reimbursement, consulting, or payer authorities- Several years of exposure to international business on a day-to-day basis- Strong track record in value generation, demonstration and/or communication- Highly experienced in conducting health economics/outcomes research across multiple specialty disciplines (e.g. patient reported outcomes, health economic modelling, real world data generation)For employees with a current contract of limited duration, legal / labor agreement requirements for contract extension will be considered.With us, you priority. jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day You lead the commodity agenda for electrical insulation and copper materials for Large Generator products. From your base in Bucharest or Mülheim, you orchestrate the commodity circle, align closely with Engineering, Quality, and Operations, and turn market insight into resilient sourcing strategies and supplier agreements that secure capacity, reduce risk, and deliver measurable cost and sustainability impact. How You’ll Make an Impact* Developing and implementing the Commodity Strategy for Large Generator portfolio in alignment with Global Commodity Strategy for Electrical Insulation components e.g. Insulating Tapes (Mica, OCP, ICP etc.), Rigid Components like Prepreg, Rings, EPGx (sheets and machined profiles), Ropes, Tubes and Laminates. Additionally responsible for commodity management of Copper based material like Copper Flats, Insulated Flat Wires, Sheets, Profiles etc. in machined form. * Lead the Commodity Circle and drive the end to end strategic procurement cycle: market analysis & scouting, should cost insights, negotiation planning, eSourcing events, award proposals, and sourcing board preparations. * Secure capacity and supply resilience via frame contracts, price lists, and multi sourcing strategies; identify and mitigate risks (e.g., tariff exposure, single source, capacity constraints) and ensure continuity for critical Large Generator demand. * Deliver measurable value (CNI/savings, total cost improvements, inventory and cash objectives) and maintain transparent KPIs and spend dashboards for your area. * Drive early supplier involvement with Engineering and SQD to accelerate NPI/continuous improvement, quality robustness, and manufacturability—translating field and supply market feedback into actionable design-to-value measures. * Manage strategic supplier relationships: performance reviews, joint improvement roadmaps, and executive governance with top suppliers in EMEA and beyond. What You Bring* Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain/Procurement, or Business—plus professional experience in direct material commodity management or category management in an industrial/manufacturing setting. * Familiarity with generator insulation systems and copper products (e.g., profiles, bars, wire, sheet) or adjacent electrical materials. Experience turning technical specs into sourcing strategies is key. * Supplier market analysis & scouting, cost modeling/should cost, competitive tendering, fact based negotiations, contracting (frame agreements/price lists), and risk management. * Proven ability to lead cross functional commodity teams (Commodity Circle) and influence at multiple levels, internally and at suppliers. * Proficiency with ERP/MRP and eSourcing platforms; comfort with KPI dashboards and data driven decisions. (Experience within Siemens Energy procurement frameworks is a plus.) * Professional fluency in English & German required for stakeholder and supplier interactions; Willingness to travel (~10–20%) for supplier visits and cross site collaboration.About the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us.
